name: apex-editor
description: Multi-tab Apex editor for Salesforce with quick anonymous Apex execution against any authenticated org.

apexEditor.executeTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for anonymous Apex execution.

apexEditor.apiVersion.description: Salesforce API version used for Tooling API calls.

apexEditor.confirmProductionRun.description: Show a confirmation dialog before running anonymous Apex against a production org (anonymous Apex executes immediately against live data).

apexEditor.customSnippets.markdownDescription: Your own code suggestions, added on top of the built-ins. Type a prefix in the editor and press Tab or Enter to insert. Use `$0` to mark where the caret lands; `$1` / `${1:placeholder}` also work (VS Code snippet syntax). A custom entry with the same `prefix` as a built-in overrides it.

prefix.description: What you type to trigger the suggestion, e.g. "sd".

label.description: Text shown in the popup (defaults to the prefix). Also matched as you type, so a label of "System.debug" is suggested when you type "system".

body.description: The inserted text. A string (use \n for newlines) or an array of lines. Use $0 for the caret position.

description.description: Optional hint shown to the right of the suggestion.
